candidates.label: Jinn hearing the Quran, believing and embracing tawheed
candidates.definition: In 72:1-3: Say O Muhammad it has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said indeed we have heard an amazing Quran; it guides to the right course and we have believed in it and we will never associate with our Lord anyone; and that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord He has not taken a wife or a son.

evidence.excerpt: قُلۡ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسۡتَمَعَ نَفَرٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا سَمِعۡنَا قُرۡءَانًا عَجَبٗا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: يَهۡدِيٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشۡدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ وَلَن نُّشۡرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدٗا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةٗ وَلَا وَلَدٗا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Human-jinn refuge-seeking increasing burden rather than providing protection
candidates.definition: In 72:6: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn so they only increased them in burden.

evidence.excerpt: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمۡ رَهَقٗا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Heaven sealed against eavesdropping with guards and flames
candidates.definition: In 72:8-9: And we have sought to reach the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames; and we used to sit therein in positions for hearing but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.

evidence.excerpt: وَأَنَّا لَمَسۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدۡنَٰهَا مُلِئَتۡ حَرَسٗا شَدِيدٗا وَشُهُبٗا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقۡعُدُ مِنۡهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمۡعِۖ فَمَن يَسۡتَمِعِ ٱلۡأٓنَ يَجِدۡ لَهُۥ شِهَابٗا رَّصَدٗا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Jinn community internally divided between righteous and unjust
candidates.definition: In 72:11-15: And among us are the righteous and among us are others not so we were of divided ways; and we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allah upon earth nor can we escape Him by flight; and when we heard the guidance we believed in it and whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden; and among us are Muslims in submission to Allah and among us are the unjust and whoever has become Muslim those have sought out the right course; but as for the unjust they will be for Hell firewood.

evidence.excerpt: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدٗا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعۡجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَن نُّعۡجِزَهُۥ هَرَبٗا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعۡنَا ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ فَمَن يُؤۡمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخۡسٗا وَلَا رَهَقٗا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلۡمُسۡلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلۡقَٰسِطُونَۖ فَمَنۡ أَسۡلَمَ فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوۡاْ رَشَدٗا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.
Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Istiqamah producing abundant provision as a divine test
candidates.definition: In 72:16: And that if they had remained straight on the way We would have given them abundant provision.

evidence.excerpt: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسۡتَقَٰمُواْ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقٗا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Masjid purity: invocation belongs to Allah alone
candidates.definition: In 72:18: And that the masjids are for Allah so do not invoke with Allah anyone.

evidence.excerpt: وَأَنَّ ٱلۡمَسَٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدۡعُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٗا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Prophetic limitation: no harm, no guidance, no refuge besides Allah
candidates.definition: In 72:21-23: Say indeed I do not possess for you the power of harm or right direction; say indeed there will never protect me from Allah anyone if I should disobey nor will I find in other than Him a refuge; but I have for you only notification from Allah and His messages.

evidence.excerpt: قُلۡ إِنِّي لَآ أَمۡلِكُ لَكُمۡ ضَرّٗا وَلَا رَشَدٗا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: قُلۡ إِنِّي لَن يُجِيرَنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٞ وَلَنۡ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلۡتَحَدًا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: إِلَّا بَلَٰغٗا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَٰلَٰتِهِۦۚ وَمَن يَعۡصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Unseen disclosed only to approved messengers under observation
candidates.definition: In 72:26-28: He is Knower of the unseen and He does not disclose His knowledge of the unseen to anyone except whom He has approved of messengers and indeed He sends before each messenger and behind him observers that he may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.

evidence.excerpt: عَٰلِمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ فَلَا يُظۡهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيۡبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرۡتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٖ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسۡلُكُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِۦ رَصَدٗا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: لِّيَعۡلَمَ أَن قَدۡ أَبۡلَغُواْ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ وَأَحۡصَىٰ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ عَدَدَۢا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.
